parameters.name: IpVersion
parameters.description:
The IP version of the back-to-origin CIDR blocks.

*   **Ipv4**
*   **Ipv6**

parameters.name: Line
parameters.description: The Internet service provider (ISP) line that you want to query.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-back-source-cidr --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --line coop-line-001 --ip-version IPv4 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
